3 /-! A pair of actual radial triangles with one chosen planar placement.
4 Compatibility always concerns the complete maps of their surface points. -/
5 
6 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
7 
8 open Set
9 
10 namespace RadialStripTriangle
11 
12 /-- Reverse an agreement without changing its actual surface correspondence. -/
13 theorem AgreesAfter.symm {P : ConvexPolyhedron}
14     {routes other : C(unitInterval, P.BoundaryCurve)} {p l r q u v : Plane}
15     {D : RadialStripTriangle routes p l r} {E : RadialStripTriangle other q u v}
16     {motion : Plane ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] Plane} (agrees : D.AgreesAfter E motion) :
17     E.AgreesAfter D motion.symm := by
18   refine ⟨agrees.1.symm, ?_⟩
19   intro x hx hy
20   rw [← agrees.2 x hy hx, motion.symm_apply_apply]
21 
22 end RadialStripTriangle
23 
24 /-- Both sides of a cut edge share this one local coordinate change. -/
25 structure PlacedCutEdgeTriangles {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {a : frontier P.body}
26     (T : P.CutLocusTree a) {u v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v)
27     extends CutEdgeTriangles T edge where
28   motion : Plane ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] Plane
29 
30 namespace PlacedCutEdgeTriangles
31 
32 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {a : frontier P.body} {T : P.CutLocusTree a}
33     {u v w z : T.vertices} {edge : T.graph.Adj u v} {other : T.graph.Adj w z}
34 
35 /-- Put the existing local placement into a selected global frame. -/
36 noncomputable def inFrame (D : PlacedCutEdgeTriangles T edge) (frame : Plane ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] Plane) :
37     PlacedCutEdgeTriangles T edge :=
38   ⟨D.toCutEdgeTriangles, D.motion.trans frame⟩
39 
40 /-- The whole paired development agrees, allowing a consistent exchange of its two labels. -/
41 def AgreesAfter (D : PlacedCutEdgeTriangles T edge) (E : PlacedCutEdgeTriangles T other)
42     (transition : Plane ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] Plane) : Prop :=
43   (((D.first_triangle.move D.motion).AgreesAfter (E.first_triangle.move E.motion) transition ∧
44     (D.second_triangle.move D.motion).AgreesAfter (E.second_triangle.move E.motion) transition) ∨
45    ((D.first_triangle.move D.motion).AgreesAfter (E.second_triangle.move E.motion) transition ∧
46     (D.second_triangle.move D.motion).AgreesAfter (E.first_triangle.move E.motion) transition))
47 
48 /-- Reversing an edge swaps its base endpoints and preserves both full triangle maps. -/
49 def Reverses (D : PlacedCutEdgeTriangles T edge) (E : PlacedCutEdgeTriangles T other)
50     (transition : Plane ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] Plane) : Prop :=
51   transition (D.motion D.model.left) = E.motion E.model.right ∧
52   transition (D.motion D.model.right) = E.motion E.model.left ∧
53   D.AgreesAfter E transition
54 
55 theorem AgreesAfter.symm {D : PlacedCutEdgeTriangles T edge} {E : PlacedCutEdgeTriangles T other}
56     {transition : Plane ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] Plane} (agrees : D.AgreesAfter E transition) :
57     E.AgreesAfter D transition.symm := by
58   rcases agrees with same | swapped
59   · exact Or.inl ⟨same.1.symm, same.2.symm⟩
60   · exact Or.inr ⟨swapped.2.symm, swapped.1.symm⟩
61 
62 theorem Reverses.symm {D : PlacedCutEdgeTriangles T edge} {E : PlacedCutEdgeTriangles T other}
63     {transition : Plane ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] Plane} (reverses : D.Reverses E transition) :
64     E.Reverses D transition.symm := by
65   refine ⟨?_, ?_, reverses.2.2.symm⟩
66   · rw [← reverses.2.1, transition.symm_apply_apply]
67   · rw [← reverses.1, transition.symm_apply_apply]
68 
69 /-- Full triangle agreement persists in any compatible pair of global frames. -/
70 theorem AgreesAfter.in_common_frame {D : PlacedCutEdgeTriangles T edge}
71     {E : PlacedCutEdgeTriangles T other} {transition : Plane ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] Plane}
72     (agrees : D.AgreesAfter E transition) (first second : Plane ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] Plane)
73     (compatible : ∀ x, second (transition x) = first x) :
74     (D.inFrame first).AgreesAfter (E.inFrame second) (AffineIsometryEquiv.refl ℝ Plane) := by
75   rcases agrees with same | swapped
76   · exact Or.inl ⟨same.1.in_common_frame first second compatible,
77       same.2.in_common_frame first second compatible⟩
78   · exact Or.inr ⟨swapped.1.in_common_frame first second compatible,
79       swapped.2.in_common_frame first second compatible⟩
80 
81 theorem Reverses.in_common_frame {D : PlacedCutEdgeTriangles T edge}
82     {E : PlacedCutEdgeTriangles T other} {transition : Plane ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] Plane}
83     (reverses : D.Reverses E transition) (first second : Plane ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] Plane)
84     (compatible : ∀ x, second (transition x) = first x) :
85     (D.inFrame first).Reverses (E.inFrame second) (AffineIsometryEquiv.refl ℝ Plane) := by
86   refine ⟨?_, ?_, reverses.2.2.in_common_frame first second compatible⟩
87   · change first (D.motion D.model.left) = second (E.motion E.model.right)
88     rw [← compatible, reverses.1]
89   · change first (D.motion D.model.right) = second (E.motion E.model.left)
90     rw [← compatible, reverses.2.1]
91 
92 /-- The genuine reverse development provides both base positions and full surface agreement. -/
93 theorem exists_reversal (D : PlacedCutEdgeTriangles T edge)
94     (E : PlacedCutEdgeTriangles T edge.symm) : ∃ transition, D.Reverses E transition := by
95   obtain ⟨motion, left, right, cases⟩ := D.toCutEdgeTriangles.reversal_agreement E.toCutEdgeTriangles
96   refine ⟨D.motion.symm.trans (motion.trans E.motion), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
97   · change E.motion (motion (D.motion.symm (D.motion D.model.left))) = E.motion E.model.right
98     rw [D.motion.symm_apply_apply, left]
99   · change E.motion (motion (D.motion.symm (D.motion D.model.right))) = E.motion E.model.left
100     rw [D.motion.symm_apply_apply, right]
101   · rcases cases with same | swapped
102     · exact Or.inl ⟨same.2.2.2.2.1.move D.motion E.motion, same.2.2.2.2.2.move D.motion E.motion⟩
103     · exact Or.inr ⟨swapped.2.2.2.2.1.move D.motion E.motion, swapped.2.2.2.2.2.move D.motion E.motion⟩
104 
105 /-- Opposite orientations of an actual cut edge admit such a complete agreement. -/
106 theorem exists_reversal_agreement (D : PlacedCutEdgeTriangles T edge)
107     (E : PlacedCutEdgeTriangles T edge.symm) : ∃ transition, D.AgreesAfter E transition := by
108   obtain ⟨transition, reverses⟩ := D.exists_reversal E
109   exact ⟨transition, reverses.2.2⟩
110 
111 end PlacedCutEdgeTriangles
112 
113 /-- Forget only the angular chart labels, retaining the actual triangles and their placement. -/
114 def IncidentTriangles.placed {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {a : frontier P.body}
115     {T : P.CutLocusTree a} {u v : T.vertices} {edge : T.graph.Adj u v}
116     {chart : P.CutVoronoiChart a (T.vertexTarget u)} {angle : ℝ}
117     (D : IncidentTriangles T edge chart angle) : PlacedCutEdgeTriangles T edge :=
118   ⟨D.toCutEdgeTriangles, D.motion⟩
119 
120 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
